title: measurements.csv rows
description: Long format: one row per compound per assay. This is what lets four papers with wildly different assay columns share one shell.

value.description: The numeric part only. A published '<0.001' stores 0.001 with qualifier '<': the pair must be rendered together and never sorted on value alone.

source_table.description: Mandatory provenance. gc validate fails the build if this is missing, per BUILD_SPEC ground rule 7.

source_note.description: Per-row footnote, for example the dose a PK value was measured at.
